brief:
Pro-Israel groups have systematically altered definitions of words central to Palestinian identity and history, according to Middle East Eye. Terms including "intifada" and "Palestine" have been redefined through organized campaigns, with consequences extending from rewritten historical narratives to the seizure of assets. The strategy employs language as a tool to reshape understanding of Palestinian struggles and territorial claims.

The semantic shifts reflect broader efforts to control how key concepts are framed in public discourse. By redefining foundational terminology, pro-Israel advocacy groups have weaponized vocabulary to advance particular political narratives regarding Palestinian history and land.

title: Pro-Israel groups reshape language to reshape Palestinian history
